CJI and EC Clash Over Form 6 Approval

Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant stated that any modified Form 6 has not been approved by the Supreme Court. In response, sources from the Election Commission (EC) defended Form 6, asserting that not a single comma had been changed and that their approval was given.
